objective: Represent realized commission and contribution efficiency against acquisition cost as exact currency-isolated integer ratios without treating premium as revenue.

semantics.realizedCommissionToAcquisitionCost: realizedCommissionMinorUnits / acquisitionCostMinorUnits represented as an exact signed integer numerator and positive integer denominator
semantics.contributionToAcquisitionCost: contributionMarginMinorUnits / acquisitionCostMinorUnits represented as an exact signed integer numerator and positive integer denominator
semantics.zeroAcquisitionCost: omit both ratios rather than divide by zero
semantics.currency: each currency is evaluated independently with no implicit conversion
semantics.premium: premium is not River revenue and is not used in either return-efficiency ratio

rules: The pure owner accepts structural currency projections containing currency, acquisitionCostMinorUnits, realizedCommissionMinorUnits, and contributionMarginMinorUnits.
Currency must be a canonical uppercase three-letter code.
Duplicate currency entries are rejected rather than aggregated.
Acquisition cost must be a safe non-negative integer.
Realized commission and contribution margin must be safe signed integers.
A positive acquisition-cost denominator produces exact numeratorMinorUnits and denominatorMinorUnits pairs.
A zero acquisition-cost denominator omits both ratios.
Negative realized commission or contribution numerators remain valid and signed.
Output currency order is deterministic ascending lexical order.
The input collection is not mutated.
No premium-to-cost return metric is produced.
No floating-point division, percentage calculation, rounding, SQL, persistence access, persistence mutation, schema change, dashboard UI, deployment, or telephony activation occurs.
